svg.title: Corleone.jl architecture
svg.desc: Corleone connects numerical integration, differentiation, optimization, and machine learning through a common shooting layer. SciMLBase and LuxCore are the primary direct interface dependencies shown. Optional extensions add symbolic modeling and plotting. Companion libraries include CorleoneOED, CorleoneInverse, and CorleoneGame. They add information-based objectives and joint experimental design, parameter estimation across experiments with uncertainty estimates, and best-response solves for dynamic games.
svg.text: Optimal control · Parameter estimation · Learned dynamics
Schedules, trajectories, objectives, and continuity constraints
